cards.front: Preparing for a job interview in the Dutch style
cards.back:
🎯 Be direct and honest about weaknesses
⚡ Avoid overly modest responses
📝 Balance honesty with showcasing strengths without exaggeration for success in Dutch interviews
cards.originalText: Oké, dus je hebt volgende week een sollicitatiegesprek? Mooi! Laat me je voorbereiden op de Nederlandse stijl. Hier zijn we heel direct, hè? Verwacht geen small talk van een half uur. Ze komen meteen ter zake. Ze gaan je vragen: 'Wat zijn je zwakke punten?' En dan moet je echt eerlijk zijn! Niet dat Amerikaanse gedoe van 'Oh, ik ben een perfectionist.' Nee, geef een echt zwak punt, maar leg dan uit hoe je eraan werkt. Nederlanders waarderen eerlijkheid enorm. Maar let op - wees niet té bescheiden. Je moet wel je sterke punten verkopen, maar zonder te overdrijven. Het is een balans, snap je?

cards.front: Improving pronunciation of the 'ö' sound in Swedish
cards.back:
🎯 Pronounce 'ö' like 'e' in 'her' with rounded lips
⚡ Compare words like 'förr' (before) and 'får' (sheep)
📝 Practice these words at home to master the correct pronunciation of the 'ö' sound in Swedish
cards.originalText: Hej allihopa! Välkommen till dagens svenska lektion! Okej, många av er har problem med 'ö'-ljudet, eller hur? Så här - det är inte som 'o' på engelska. Det är mer som 'e' i 'her' eller 'bird', men med rundade läppar. Titta här... 'ööö'. Prova nu! Ett bra knep är att jämföra ord. Säg 'förr' - det betyder 'before'. Nu säg 'får' - det betyder 'sheep'. Hör ni skillnaden? 'Förr' har 'ö', 'får' har 'å'. Öva dessa två ord hemma, det hjälper jättemycket!

cards.back:
🎯 Emphasizes humility and collectivism over individual achievements
⚡ Core principle: 'Du skal ikke tro at du er noe'
📝 Influences business communication by promoting modesty and avoiding boasting
cards.originalText: Janteloven er et sett med sosiale normer i nordiske land som understreker ydmykhet og kollektivisme over individuell prestasjoner. 'Du skal ikke tro at du er noe' er et kjerneelement. Dette påvirker hvordan nordmenn kommuniserer i forretningssammenheng - de unngår å skryte og foretrekker understatement.

cards.back:
🎯 Students start reading at 7 but excel in PISA tests
⚡ Emphasizes play, creativity, critical thinking over standardized tests
📝 Focuses on early childhood education
cards.originalText: Suomalainen koulutusjärjestelmä on tunnettu siitä, että oppilaat aloittavat lukemaan vasta 7-vuotiaina, mutta saavuttavat silti korkeita tuloksia PISA-testeissä. Järjestelmä korostaa leikkiä, luovuutta ja kriittistä ajattelua standardoitujen testien sijaan varhaiskasvatuksessa.

cards.front: Technical questions in a developer interview (German)
cards.back:
🎯 Explain State Management in React and benefits of Redux
⚡ Differentiate between Redux, useState, Zustand, and Context API
📝 Address strategies for handling performance issues in slow applications
cards.originalText: So, Sie sind also unser neuer Entwickler? Gut, dann erklären Sie mir doch mal: Wie funktioniert eigentlich State Management in React? Und warum sollten wir Redux verwenden statt einfach nur useState? Ich habe gehört, dass es auch andere Lösungen gibt wie Zustand oder Context API. Was ist denn da der Unterschied? Und noch eine Frage: Wie gehen Sie mit Performance-Problemen um, wenn die App langsam wird?

cards.front: Addressing project delays in a meeting (German)
cards.back:
🎯 Explain reasons for the 3-week delay and propose solutions
⚡ Provide concrete action plans, not just excuses
📝 Prepare to present solutions to management and ensure prevention of future delays
cards.originalText: Also, ich schaue mir hier die Zahlen für Ihr Projekt an... Können Sie mir erklären, warum wir schon 3 Wochen im Verzug sind? Was ist da schiefgelaufen? Und wie wollen Sie das wieder aufholen? Ich brauche konkrete Lösungen, nicht nur Entschuldigungen. Die Geschäftsleitung will morgen Antworten. Also, was schlagen Sie vor? Wie stellen Sie sicher, dass so etwas nicht wieder passiert?

cards.back:
🎯 Describe Quantum Entanglement concept and Einstein's 'spooky action at a distance'
⚡ Provide a practical example and discuss its significance in modern physics
📝 Prepare a concise explanation within two minutes for an oral exam
cards.originalText: Gut, kommen wir zur mündlichen Prüfung. Erklären Sie mir doch bitte das Konzept der Quantenverschränkung. Wie funktioniert das genau? Und was hat Einstein damit gemeint, als er von 'spukhafter Fernwirkung' sprach? Können Sie mir ein praktisches Beispiel geben? Und welche Bedeutung hat das für die moderne Physik? Zeit haben Sie zwei Minuten für die Antwort.

cards.front: Addressing funding questions in a startup pitch
cards.back:
🎯 Explain customer acquisition cost and scalability plans
⚡ Highlight unique selling points compared to competitors
📝 Provide detailed financial projections, burn rate, and path to profitability
cards.originalText: Alright, so you're asking for 2 million dollars. Let's see if you've done your homework. What's your customer acquisition cost? How do you plan to scale this? I see here you have competitors - what makes you different? And frankly, your burn rate concerns me. How long will this funding actually last you? Give me some hard numbers. What's your path to profitability? Because I've seen too many startups with great ideas but no business sense.

cards.back:
🎯 Inquire about pain onset, nature, intensity, aggravating factors
⚡ Ask about medications, family history, and accompanying symptoms
📝 Encourage specific and detailed responses for accurate diagnosis and treatment
cards.originalText: I need to ask you some questions about your symptoms. When did this pain start exactly? Is it constant or does it come and go? On a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate it? Does anything make it worse? Better? Have you taken any medications for it? Any family history of similar problems? Are you experiencing any other symptoms - nausea, dizziness, shortness of breath? I need you to be very specific here.

cards.front: Technical questions on REST, GraphQL, and database optimization
cards.back:
🎯 Explain differences between REST and GraphQL, and when to use each
⚡ Describe optimizing a slow database query and troubleshooting high traffic scenarios
📝 Prepare to discuss technical scenarios within a 5-minute timeframe
cards.originalText: Let's dive into some technical questions. Can you explain the difference between REST and GraphQL? When would you choose one over the other? Now, tell me about a time you had to optimize a slow database query. What was your approach? And here's a scenario: your API is getting 10x more traffic than expected and response times are slow. Walk me through how you'd diagnose and fix this. You have 5 minutes.
